o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *köt- (“to rise, to raise; high, elevated”), whence also göt (“ass, buttocks”).
further cognates
Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰚𐰇𐱅𐰇𐰼 (kötür-, “to raise, lift”), causative of 𐰚𐰇𐱅 (köt, “high, elevated”), Turkish götürmek, Kazakh көтеру (köterüw, “to lift, raise”), Kyrgyz көтөрүү (kötörüü, “to rise”), Turkmen götermek (“to lift, pick up”), Uyghur كۆتەرمەك (kötermek, “to pick, raise”), Uzbek ko'tarmoq (“to raise, heighten”), Chuvash кот (kot), and Yakut көт (köt, “to fly”).
Possibly a derivation of Proto-Common Turkic *yog- (“to become denser, to thicken”).
From Russian вайфа́й (vajfáj), from English Wi-Fi.
